analyst.summary: Azad Engineering is a precision-forged aerospace and defence components maker riding India's genuine defence-indigenization wave, capped by a real recent milestone (delivering India's first indigenous expendable turbo-jet engine to DRDO in July 2026) and management guidance for 50-80% FY27 revenue growth. The valuation is very rich (~117x earnings) and current returns on capital (ROE ~11%) have not yet caught up to the growth story, which is still capital-intensive. We rate it a Hold.
